---
title: DuckDB
---

A `duckdb` database entry can be added by specifying `type: duckdb` in your
project's [`config.yml`](/guide/reference/yaml/config). There are two ways to
point it at your data.

## A directory of files

Set `dataset` to the directory where your data files (CSV, Parquet, …) are
stored. Oxygen runs `SET file_search_path = '<dataset>'` before every query, so
you can query files by name.

```yaml
databases:
  - name: local
    type: duckdb
    dataset: .db/
```

Directory sources are read-only.

## A DuckDB database file

Set `path` to a `.db` file:

```yaml
databases:
  - name: analytics
    type: duckdb
    path: data/analytics.db
```

Use a file database when you need to write to it — for example, as the output
of [modeling](/guide/build/semantic-model/modeling).
